{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or neutral, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if model shows overreaction to recent price spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if 3-5 consecutive days show downward drift, slightly lower next forecast.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment turns positive after a dip, anticipate rebound.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast windows; use lagged sentiment to temper short-term overestimates.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms model (e.g., 3+ consecutive underperformance), reduce forecast by 5-15%.",
    "For high volatility periods, apply smoothing: reduce forecast variance by 10-20% to avoid erratic swings.",
    "When sentiment is neutral, prioritize historical mean or 30-day moving average over model trend."
  ]
}
